# mux_transcription_vocabulary (Resource)

A transcription vocabulary: words, phrases and proper names that speech recognition should favor in the generated subtitles of the live streams that use it (`mux_live_stream.generated_subtitles`). A change does not reach a stream that is active.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mux_transcription_vocabulary" "products" {
  name    = "Product names"
  phrases = ["Mux", "OpenTofu", "Terraform"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `phrases` (Set of String) The phrases, at most 1000, each of 1 to 32 characters. The order does not matter.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the vocabulary.
- `passthrough` (String) Arbitrary metadata, at most 255 characters.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the vocabulary was created, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
- `id` (String) Transcription vocabulary ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by transcription vocabulary ID.
terraform import mux_transcription_vocabulary.products VDm3npt2eaEDvz9emzun8Q
```
